title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Domain-Diverse Root Quorum and Trust-Sybil Resistance Extension
problem_statement: A multi-signature design is not independently witnessed merely because several keys sign it. If the keys share one failure or control domain, one compromise can manufacture apparent quorum.

new_primitives.TRUST_DOMAIN_ID: Identifier for an independently governed or independently failing attestation boundary.
new_primitives.ROOT_CREDENTIAL_ID: Individual credential within a trust domain.
new_primitives.DOMAIN_MEMBERSHIP_BINDING: Record that prevents one domain from presenting many credentials as many independent domains.
new_primitives.DOMAIN_DIVERSE_QUORUM: Admission rule expressed in distinct trust domains rather than raw key count.
new_primitives.DISSENT_RECEIPT: Preserved record when a trust domain reports a different checkpoint binding.
new_primitives.ROOT_REGISTRY_VERSION: Versioned registry defining which trust domains and credential lineages were accepted for a specific checkpoint era.

admission_rule.minimum: two distinct registered trust domains for the baseline model

trust_domain_requirements: no retroactive reclassification of a historical signature to manufacture quorum

dissent_protocol.two_domains_agree_one_disagrees: Preserve dissent and admit only if current policy threshold is met; disagreement remains auditable.
dissent_protocol.three_distinct_roots: Do not combine or average incompatible roots.

sybil_resistance.face_parallel: One face cannot spawn many faces to gain votes.
sybil_resistance.root_parallel: One trust domain cannot spawn many keys to gain independent witness weight.

implementation_tests: ten keys from one domain fail a two-domain quorum
two exact attestations from distinct domains pass baseline quorum
dissent receipt survives admission by other domains
credentials cannot be reassigned to new domains retroactively
incompatible roots cannot be averaged or silently selected by raw signature majority
boundaries: Distinct trust domains can still collude or share hidden dependencies.
Domain diversity is an engineering independence model, not proof of absolute independence.
Attestation still proves integrity/binding relative to trust assumptions, not semantic truth.
canonical_lines: Ten keys in one hand are still one hand.
Dissent is evidence to preserve, not noise to delete.
